responses-reference.excerpt: The page header and the input, max_output_tokens, stream, temperature, top_p and user body parameters, and the Streaming example.

rules.quote: The Assistants API was officially sunset on August 26, 2026, and is no longer available.
rules.summary: Calls the Assistants API, which OpenAI shut down on 2026-08-26, so these requests fail today. The move is not one-to-one: assistants become Prompts (configured in the dashboard), threads become Conversations, runs become Responses, and the tool-call loop moves into your code. Refit lists each call for review and does not rewrite it.

rules.quote: Access to these models was shut down on September 28, 2026.
rules.summary: Calls legacy Completions (`completions.create` / `createCompletion`). Every model it served (gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, babbage-002, davinci-002) shut down on 2026-09-28, so the call needs a new model and a new API. OpenAI's Responses migration guide covers Chat Completions only; `prompt`, `suffix`, `echo`, `best_of` and `logprobs` have no documented mapping, so Refit lists it for review.

rules.quote: Responses is recommended for all new projects.
rules.summary: A legacy Completions request (`completions.create`) whose retired model has a registry replacement moves to the Responses API (`responses.create`), with the replacement model, when every parameter and every read of its response has a mapping below. Anything else stops for review.
`responses.create` exists from openai 4.87.0; a repository on an older release stops (the SDK-major migration moves it first).

rules.quote: Text, image, or file inputs to the model, used to generate a response.
rules.summary: `prompt` becomes `input`. Only a prompt Refit can see is one string moves; Completions also takes arrays of prompts or tokens, which `input` does not.

rules.quote: An upper bound for the number of tokens that can be generated for a response, including visible output tokens and
rules.summary: `max_tokens` becomes `max_output_tokens`, which also counts reasoning tokens and has a minimum of 16; a value below 16 or not written as a number stops.

rules.quote: What sampling temperature to use, between 0 and 2.
rules.summary: `temperature`, `top_p`, `stream` and `user` keep their names on Responses; whether the replacement model accepts the sampling parameters is decided by the model-parameter rules, as for any swap. Every other Completions parameter (`stop`, `suffix`, `echo`, `best_of`, `n`, `logprobs`, `logit_bias`, penalties, `seed`) has no Responses parameter and stops.

rules.quote: The Responses SDK has an `output_text` helper, which the Chat Completions SDK does not have.
rules.summary: A read of `choices[0].text` on the awaited response becomes `output_text`. Any other read of the response (`choices` as a whole, `usage`, `finish_reason`) stops.

rules.quote: Update stream consumers to branch on each event's `type` and handle the events your UI or orchestration layer needs.
rules.summary: In a `for await` loop over a streamed response, `chunk.choices[0].text` becomes the text of `response.output_text.delta` events (`delta`), and '' for every other event. A stream handed to anything but such a loop stops.

rules.quote: The Assistants API was officially sunset on August 26, 2026, and is no longer available.
rules.summary: Python calls the Assistants API, shut down on 2026-08-26. Python is report only.
